findings.problem: Increment C changes `ask-codex` and `model-bridge.md` to contract version 2, but Increment D (which depends on C) is the first increment to recognize and implement `--confine`. Contract version 2 requires all bridges to recognize `--confine`, and a program bridge may accept it only when it actually disables the required tools. Thus the verified local commit for C would advertise contract 2 while failing its required option contract until D.
findings.suggestion: Make the contract-2 transition atomic with the `--confine` implementation (for example, combine C and D), or implement `--confine` in C and reserve D for the release-check documentation. Keep B before that transition so both engines accept either version.

summary: The plan otherwise reflects the named roadmap candidate and three specs, but its C-to-D sequencing temporarily produces a nonconforming contract-version-2 bridge.
